title: Professional Barcode Scanner Upgrade & Address Correction

requirements.text: Update the hardcoded billing address to 'Bardiha Turki - Tarvadih (Patepur-Vaishali 843110), Bihar' and ensure it appears at the top of every generated bill/invoice along with the store name

quotes: Please update the official store address on all generated bills/receipts. The address must be exactly as follows: Bardiha Turki - Tarvadih (Patepur-Vaishali 843110), Bihar.

acceptanceCriteria: Address 'Bardiha Turki - Tarvadih (Patepur-Vaishali 843110), Bihar' is printed at the top of every bill
Address appears on both screen-displayed bills and printed receipts
Store name is displayed alongside the address

requirements.text: Replace the current Quagga2 barcode scanner with a zero-latency, high-performance scanner that uses enhanced decoding algorithms capable of reading barcodes even when blurred, tilted, or in low-light conditions

quotes: The current barcode scanner is slow and often fails. I want a professional-grade scanning experience
Zero-Latency Scanning: Integrate a low-latency library (like Dynamsoft or Scandit approach) that detects barcodes as soon as they enter the camera frame
Enhanced Decoder: Ensure the scanner can read barcodes even if they are slightly blurred, tilted, or in low-light conditions

acceptanceCriteria: Barcode detection occurs within milliseconds of barcode entering camera frame
Scanner successfully reads barcodes that are slightly blurred
Scanner successfully reads barcodes that are tilted at various angles
Scanner functions effectively in low-light conditions
No perceptible lag between barcode presentation and detection

requirements.text: Add haptic feedback (phone vibration) and a success beep sound that triggers instantly upon successful barcode scan

quotes: Haptic Feedback: The phone should give a short Vibration (Haptic feedback) and a 'Success' beep sound instantly upon a successful scan.

acceptanceCriteria: Phone vibrates immediately when barcode is successfully scanned
Success beep sound plays immediately when barcode is successfully scanned
Haptic and audio feedback occur simultaneously
Feedback triggers only on successful scans, not on failed attempts

requirements.text: Implement auto-quantity increment functionality so that scanning the same barcode multiple times automatically increases the quantity (e.g., Qty: 2) in the bill instead of showing an error or adding duplicate line items

quotes: Auto-Quantity Increment: If the same barcode is scanned twice, the system should automatically increase the quantity (Qty: 2) in the bill instead of showing an error or adding a new line.

acceptanceCriteria: Scanning the same barcode twice increments quantity to 2 on the existing line item
Each additional scan of the same barcode continues to increment quantity
No error messages appear when scanning duplicate barcodes
No duplicate line items are created for the same product
Quantity updates are reflected immediately in the bill preview

requirements.text: Add a professional scanning overlay UI to the camera view with either a laser line or square box guide so the admin knows exactly where to point the barcode for optimal scanning

quotes: Overlay UI: Add a professional scanning 'Laser Line' or 'Square Box' overlay on the camera screen so the admin knows exactly where to point the barcode.

acceptanceCriteria: Camera view displays a visible scanning guide (laser line or square box)
Overlay clearly indicates the optimal barcode placement area
Overlay does not obstruct camera view or interfere with scanning
Overlay appears professional and matches the app's design system

requirements.text: Ensure the final bill total is synced with the payment gateway for seamless checkout after barcode scanning is complete and the bill is generated

quotes: Once the scan is complete and the bill is generated with the correct Bardiha Turki address, ensure the final total is synced with the Payment Gateway for a seamless checkout.

acceptanceCriteria: Bill total is accurately transmitted to payment gateway
Payment gateway displays the correct amount from the generated bill
Checkout flow works seamlessly after bill generation
No manual entry of payment amount is required

requirements.text: Update the camera permission description in the app settings to: 'This app uses the camera to provide a high-speed, professional barcode scanning experience for instant billing and inventory management.'

quotes: Camera Permission Description: "This app uses the camera to provide a high-speed, professional barcode scanning experience for instant billing and inventory management."

acceptanceCriteria: Camera permission prompt displays the specified description
Description accurately reflects the professional barcode scanning functionality
Text appears when user is first prompted for camera permissions

constraints: Must maintain compatibility with existing bill generation and printing functionality
Must not modify the backend schema or main actor structure
Scanner must work on mobile devices with standard camera hardware
Must preserve existing product lookup and billing workflow
nonGoals: Changing the overall UI/UX design of the billing page beyond the scanner overlay
Modifying the payment gateway integration beyond syncing the total amount
Integrating third-party barcode scanning cloud services that require API keys
